# three.js

`three.min.js` here is three.js r147 (0.147.0, from the npm package `three`), used by `kaiju.html` (the 3D-pixel city test).
Vendored (not loaded from a CDN) so the page also works where the CDN is blocked.
three.js: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js — Copyright © 2010-2022 three.js authors, MIT License (see LICENSE in this folder).
`GLTFLoader.js` is `examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js` from the same three.js 0.147.0 npm package (MIT), used by `tribe3d.html` to load the Blender models in `art/tribe3d/models/`.
`SkeletonUtils.js` = `examples/js/utils/SkeletonUtils.js` of the same package (MIT): clones skinned (animated) models such as the Quaternius animals.
